blocked.heading: Add a chat model first
blocked.body: An assistant needs a chat model to write its answers, and this workspace has none yet.
blocked.bodyMember: Ask the workspace owner or an admin to add one.

field.name: Name
field.pictureHelp: PNG or JPEG, up to 1 MB. It is shrunk to fit.
field.datasetsHelp: The assistant answers from these. Choose none to chat without sources.
field.systemHelp: How the assistant should behave. The retrieved passages and the citation rules are added automatically.
field.prologueHelp: Shown at the top of every new chat.
field.emptyHelp: Sent instead of an answer when no passage is relevant enough. The chat model isn't called.
field.thresholdHelp: Passages scoring below this are ignored. Higher means stricter.
field.weightHelp: How much a passage's score comes from matching words and how much from meaning.
field.topNHelp: How many passages are given to the chat model.
field.rerankHelp: Reorders the passages with a dedicated model. Slower, usually more accurate.

picture.type: Choose a PNG or JPEG image.
picture.size: The image is larger than 1 MB.

visibility.meBody: Only you can see and use this assistant.
visibility.teamBody: Everyone in {{workspace}} can use it. Each person's chats stay private. Only the person who made it, the owner and admins can change or delete it.
visibility.reason: Remove the datasets that only you can see, or share them first.
visibility.narrowingInfo: It can go back to "Only me" only when no teammate has chats with it.
visibility.narrowingCreator: After the switch, only the person who made it can see it, and it leaves your list.

datasets.privateReason: Only you can see this dataset, so a shared assistant can't use it.
datasets.skipped_one: {{count}} dataset used by this assistant isn't available to you. It stays linked.
datasets.skipped_other: {{count}} datasets used by this assistant aren't available to you. They stay linked.

default.system: You are a helpful assistant. Answer using only the knowledge you are given. If it does not contain the answer, say that you could not find it.
default.prologue: Hello. Ask me a question about your documents.
default.empty: I couldn't find anything about that in the selected datasets.

saved.narrowed: Assistant saved. Only the person who made it can see it now.

error.duplicate: An assistant named "{{name}}" already exists in this workspace. Choose another name.
error.notShared: This assistant can't be shared while it uses datasets that aren't shared with the team.
error.narrowing_one: This assistant can't be made private while {{count}} teammate has chats with it. Ask them to delete those chats, then try again.
error.narrowing_other: This assistant can't be made private while {{count}} teammates have chats with it. Ask them to delete those chats, then try again.
error.dataset: A dataset you chose is no longer available. Choose again.
error.model: That model is no longer available in this workspace. Choose another one.
error.fallback: The assistant wasn't saved. Try again.

deleteChat.title: Delete this chat?
deleteChat.body: "{{name}}" and its answers will be deleted. This can't be undone.
deleteChat.failed: The chat wasn't deleted. Try again.

delete.title: Delete this assistant?
delete.body: "{{name}}" will be deleted together with all of its chats. Datasets aren't affected.
delete.bodyTeam_one: "{{name}}" will be deleted together with all of its chats, including the chats of {{count}} other member. Datasets aren't affected.
delete.bodyTeam_other: "{{name}}" will be deleted together with all of its chats, including the chats of {{count}} other members. Datasets aren't affected.
delete.failed: The assistant wasn't deleted. Try again.

assistant.topNRange: Enter a whole number from 1 to 30.
assistant.scoreRange: Choose a value from 0 to 1 in steps of 0.05.
